scope: Proposition 8.3 (Two direction-recording placements) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The direction recorder gives both of the following realizations. 1. On R3, with its passive origin bit, there is a force periodic from time zero and a fixed-origin event X1(t; 0) < −5. Input dependence can be confined to two translations of the state charts. On every implemented full box the first coordinate is a convex combination of its endpoint first coordinates. 2. On the unit torus, without the passive track, a force periodic after t = 1 has fixed label (1/8, 1/8, 1/4) and event x1 ∈ (1/2, 7/8) (mod 1). For a fixed machine its repeated part is independent of the input. Both events are equivalent to halting.
